label: Supabase
terms_note: Free plan allows commercial use (2 projects, pause after 7 idle days, 402 on fair-use overage); Management API 120 req/min per user+project (X-RateLimit-* headers; analytics 30/min, database context 10/min); PAT or OAuth2 app scopes; MCP hosted, OAuth/DCR or PAT; no partner gate

endpoints.purpose: provision a database for a dynamic_node / ai_agent build
endpoints.notes: body `name`, `organization_slug`, `db_pass` (req), `region_selection`, `desired_instance_size`, `template_url`, `high_availability` → `{id, ref, status: INACTIVE→ACTIVE_HEALTHY, region}`; scope `projects:write`

endpoints.purpose: ship server logic as an Edge Function
endpoints.notes: multipart `file[]` + `metadata {name, entrypoint_path, verify_jwt, import_map_path}` → `{id, slug, status, version}`; scope `edge_functions:write`

endpoints.purpose: fetch the publishable / secret keys to bake into the build's env
app data CRUD from the build (what the row grants today)
endpoints.notes: headers `apikey`, `Authorization: Bearer <user jwt or secret key>`, `Prefer: return=representation`; filters as query (`?id=eq.1&select=*`)

reference.limits: Management API: **120 req/min** per user per project/org, headers `X-RateLimit-Limit / -Remaining / -Reset`; analytics endpoints 30/min, database-context 10/min (1/s burst); 429 on breach. Data API: no fixed request cap on any plan; Auth endpoints have their own per-IP limits (configurable). Free plan: 2 active projects, 500 MB DB, 5 GB egress, pauses after 7 idle days, **402 on fair-use overage**. Commercial use allowed on every plan incl. Free. No partner gate for the Management API / MCP. ToS forbids sublicensing / competing-service use; provisioning projects *on behalf of a tenant under t
mcp_sdk: SDKs: `@supabase/supabase-js`, `supabase-py`, Supabase CLI (`supabase db push`, `supabase functions deploy`, `supabase gen types`).

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: Project secret key (sb_secret_…, Project Settings > API Keys), sent in the apikey header as Supabase documents for publishable/secret keys. It bypasses Row Level Security: keep it server-side.

list_items.note: GET /rest/v1/{table}?select=*&limit&offset: rows of the table named by collection (required). Each row is in raw; id/title/updated_at are read from columns of those names when present. query is not sent (PostgREST filters are column-specific).

get_item.note: GET /rest/v1/{table}?id=eq.{item_id}&select=*: the row whose id column equals item_id (the table needs an `id` column).

create_item.note: POST /rest/v1/{table} [fields] with Prefer: return=representation: inserts one row whose columns are the keys of fields; title/content are not columns and are not sent.

update_item.note: Upsert: POST /rest/v1/{table} [{id: item_id, …fields}] with Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates: updates the given columns of the row whose primary key `id` equals item_id (inserts it when missing).

delete_item.note: DELETE /rest/v1/{table}?id=eq.{item_id}: deletes the row(s) whose id equals item_id.

not_offered.me: The Data API (PostgREST) has no identity endpoint for a secret key; the Management API (GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}) needs a separate personal access token.

evidence: probe: 0/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> None (timeout), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
auth_audit.notes: Per-project host (<project_ref>.supabase.co): no public project exists to probe and unknown refs do not resolve, so only the PostgREST path shape (/rest/v1/<table>) could be checked, against Supabase's docs. no answer (timeout/connection) for list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item
